articles.summary: Celebrate the colder weather and give your space the touch of fall it needs with these cute leather pumpkins! Using soft 1-3 oz leather, some thread, and contact cement, you’ll have a leather pumpkin patch ready to go in no time. Be sure to have some stuffing on hand as well to give these gourds their full, round shape
articles.title: Leather Pumpkins: Free Pattern & Tutorial
